supplements.title: Impact of leucine-rich diet on placenta's proteomic and metabolomic profiles of pregnant tumor-bearing rats.
supplements.summary: A leucine-rich diet may protect placental and fetal development in pregnant rats with cancer by reducing tumor-induced molecular damage.

supplements.title: Betulinic acid alleviates the inflammatory injury of osteoblasts in osteoporosis by augmenting autophagy via the AMPK-mTOR signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Betulinic acid protects bone cells from inflammatory damage in osteoporosis by activating autophagy through the AMPK-mTOR pathway.

supplements.title: Tauroursodeoxycholic acid (TUDCA) ameliorates age-related skeletal muscle loss.
supplements.summary: TUDCA, a bile acid, restores muscle mass and function in aging mice by improving insulin sensitivity and reducing inflammation.

supplements.title: Human multi-tissue transcriptomics identifies galectin-1 and follistatin-like 1 as exerkines with distinct transcript-to-serum coupling after exercise.
supplements.summary: Exercise increases galectin-1 and follistatin-like 1 in the blood, with body composition determining how much enters circulation.

supplements.title: Lactucin inhibits growth and induces apoptosis in gastric cancer cells by targeting MAPK signaling.
supplements.summary: Lactucin, a natural compound from chicory, stops gastric cancer cell growth and triggers cell death by blocking a key cellular pathway.

supplements.title: Atractylenolide I Blocks Lung Metastasis of Triple-Negative Breast Cancer by Inhibiting SPP1-Mediated Extracellular Matrix Signaling Pathway.
supplements.summary: Atractylenolide I, a plant compound, blocks triple-negative breast cancer spread to the lungs by disrupting a protein involved in metastasis.

supplements.title: Anticancer activity of Hebesu extracts in cancer cell lines.
supplements.summary: Hebesu citrus extract kills breast, liver, and lung cancer cells by triggering cell death and blocking cancer-promoting genes.

supplements.title: Ginsenosides in the management of depression: a comprehensive pharmacological review.
supplements.summary: Ginsenosides from ginseng show promise treating depression through multiple mechanisms including neurotransmitter modulation and reduced brain inflammation.

supplements.title: Improved anticancer efficacy of plant leaf extracts from homa environment: A preliminary study.
supplements.summary: Plant leaf extracts from homa-treated environments show improved cancer-fighting effectiveness compared to standard sources.

supplements.title: Interactions Between ADIPOQ rs1501299 Polymorphism, Dietary Macronutrient Composition, and Gastric Cancer Risk: Evidence from a Korean Case-Control Study.
supplements.summary: A genetic variant in the ADIPOQ gene modified how diet's macronutrient balance affected gastric cancer risk in Korean adults.

supplements.title: A BBB-permeable β3-AR probe enables redox imaging, natural inhibitors discovery, and therapeutic monitoring in glioblastoma.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed a brain-penetrating probe that visualizes β3-receptors and monitors stress levels in glioblastoma, identifying baicalin as a natural drug candidate.

supplements.title: Ultraprocessed Foods and the Aging Brain: State of the Science.
supplements.summary: High ultraprocessed food consumption may harm brain aging through poor nutrition and added chemicals, though more research is needed.

supplements.title: Melatonin Receptor Signaling in Human Pathologies: From Molecular Mechanisms to Therapeutic Targets.
supplements.summary: Melatonin receptor signaling dysfunction contributes to multiple diseases including cancer, diabetes, and neurodegeneration, offering new therapeutic targets.

supplements.title: Pretreatment of soybean hulls hemicellulose in ionic liquid facilitates anti-inflammatory oligosaccharides preparation.
supplements.summary: Researchers used ionic liquid pretreatment to extract anti-inflammatory compounds from soybean hulls more efficiently and effectively.

supplements.title: Structure-property relationships in saccharide-derived carbon dots: Tuning oxygen functionalities and sp2 domains for antioxidant performance.
supplements.summary: Researchers created carbon dots from xylose that effectively neutralize harmful free radicals while remaining safe for cells.

off_label.title: Combination of ivermectin and metformin promotes autophagy in MCF‑7 cells by inhibiting phosphorylation of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway.
off_label.summary: Combining ivermectin and metformin kills breast cancer cells by triggering autophagy through increased oxidative stress and pathway inhibition.

off_label.title: The role of ATP synthase subunit e (ATP5I) in mediating the metabolic and antiproliferative effects of metformin in cancer cells.
off_label.summary: Metformin fights pancreatic cancer and osteosarcoma by targeting ATP5I protein, disrupting cancer cell energy production and blocking growth.

off_label.title: LKB1 Loss Sensitizes Lung Tumor Spheres to Mitomet-Induced Ferroptosis, and These Effects are Enhanced by mTOR Inhibition.
off_label.summary: LKB1-mutant lung cancer stem cells die when treated with mitomet and mTOR inhibitors through ferroptosis, a new therapeutic approach.

off_label.title: Inhibition of ceramide synthesis ameliorates body wasting in a cancer cachexia model.
off_label.summary: Blocking ceramide production in the liver reduces muscle wasting in cancer cachexia, offering a potential new treatment approach.

off_label.title: Dopamine D2 Receptor Agonists as Modulators of VEGF-A-Driven Angiogenesis: Mechanisms, Clinical Evidence, and Translational Opportunities.
off_label.summary: Dopamine D2 receptor agonists suppress tumor blood vessel growth by blocking VEGF-A signaling, offering a potential new cancer treatment approach.

off_label.title: Simvastatin Restores Cisplatin Sensitivity by Suppressing the Caveolin-1-Mediated PI3K/AKT Signaling Pathway in Cisplatin-Resistant Cervical Cancer Cells.
off_label.summary: Simvastatin restores cisplatin effectiveness in resistant cervical cancer by blocking a key resistance pathway, suggesting it could improve chemotherapy outcomes.

off_label.title: Nintedanib is a potent FLT3 inhibitor with activity against FLT3-ITD and overcomes the gatekeeper F691L resistance mutation in acute myeloid leukemia.
off_label.summary: Nintedanib, a lung disease drug, effectively treats acute myeloid leukemia by blocking FLT3 mutations, even resistant ones.

off_label.title: Toremifene in desmoid fibromatosis: Prospective phase 2 study of two dose levels.
off_label.summary: A study tested whether toremifene, an existing drug, safely and effectively treats desmoid fibromatosis at different dose levels.

off_label.title: Breast cancer tumor immune microenvironment landscape identifies prognostic risk genes and potential drugs.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified four immune genes linked to breast cancer prognosis and discovered two promising drugs targeting these genes.

off_label.title: Unraveling the molecular landscape and therapeutic strategies for acute kidney injury: insights from transcriptomics, network pharmacology, virtual screening, and in vitro experiments.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified three key genes and three existing drugs that may help treat acute kidney injury by targeting inflammation and oxidative stress.

off_label.title: NUP62 promotes breast cancer progression and inhibits ferroptosis by stabilizing NRF2 in a KEAP1-dependent way.
off_label.summary: NUP62 protein drives breast cancer growth by blocking cell death; the drug eribulin reverses this by targeting NUP62.

off_label.title: Mechanism of CRM1 Inhibition by Lansoprazole and Its Synergy with Cisplatin in Gastric Cancer.
off_label.summary: Lansoprazole inhibits a cancer protein (CRM1) in gastric cancer and works synergistically with cisplatin to improve treatment outcomes.

off_label.title: Integrated Multiomics Analysis Suggests Statin-Associated Perturbation of DNA Repair Signaling in Colorectal Cancer Cells.
off_label.summary: Statins disrupt DNA repair signaling in colorectal cancer cells, potentially making them more vulnerable to chemotherapy.

off_label.title: A Pilot Study of Chemoprevention With Tamoxifen in Patients With Pre-Invasive Pancreas Mucinous Cystic Neoplasms Who Will Not Undergo Immediate Resection
off_label.summary: Researchers test tamoxifen to shrink or stabilize pancreatic precancerous cysts, potentially avoiding surgery.

off_label.title: NIDA CTN-0152: Evaluation of Tirzepatide as an Adjunct to Buprenorphine for the Treatment of Opioid Use Disorder: A Pragmatic, Multi-site, Double-blind, Randomized, Placebo-controlled Trial (TAB)
off_label.summary: Study tests whether tirzepatide added to buprenorphine improves treatment outcomes for opioid use disorder.

biomarkers.title: Quality of life in hospitalized patients receiving palliative care: Do current tools cover all their needs?
biomarkers.summary: Current quality of life assessment tools for hospitalized palliative care patients may not adequately measure all patient needs across cancer and non-cancer conditions.

biomarkers.title: Impact of leucine-rich diet on placenta's proteomic and metabolomic profiles of pregnant tumor-bearing rats.
biomarkers.summary: A leucine-rich diet may protect placental and fetal development in pregnant rats with cancer by reducing tumor-induced molecular damage.

biomarkers.title: Exosome and biotherapeutic strategies for dermatological and oncological skin complications.
biomarkers.summary: Exosomes show promise treating skin cancer complications by delivering healing molecules and regulating inflammation and immune responses.

biomarkers.title: FAS-controlled T cells drive lymphoproliferation through glycolysis without effector differentiation.
biomarkers.summary: FAS-deficient T cells proliferate excessively through increased glycolysis without developing into typical immune-fighting cells.

biomarkers.title: Hepatic p38γ exacerbates acetaminophen‑induced acute liver injury via PI3K/Akt‑dependent mechanisms.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking the p38γ protein reduces acetaminophen-induced liver injury by decreasing inflammation, oxidative stress, and fat accumulation in liver cells.

biomarkers.title: Rab27: Molecular switch of tumor exosome secretion (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Rab27 protein controls tumor growth by regulating exosome secretion, offering potential as a cancer biomarker and drug target.

biomarkers.title: Combination of ivermectin and metformin promotes autophagy in MCF‑7 cells by inhibiting phosphorylation of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway.
biomarkers.summary: Combining ivermectin and metformin kills breast cancer cells by triggering autophagy through increased oxidative stress and pathway inhibition.

biomarkers.title: Cancer signaling networks in tumor progression and drug resistance: Crosstalk, adaptive reprogramming and therapeutic targeting (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Cancer cells evade drugs by rewiring interconnected signaling networks, requiring multi-target therapies instead of single-pathway inhibition strategies.

biomarkers.title: CircRAD18 promotes glioblastoma proliferation, migration and invasion via the miR‑1231/LUC7L2 axis.
biomarkers.summary: CircRAD18 promotes glioblastoma growth and spread through a specific molecular pathway, offering potential for diagnosis and treatment.

biomarkers.title: SRRT promotes prostate cancer progression and serves as a prognostic biomarker through STAT3 pathway activation.
biomarkers.summary: SRRT protein promotes prostate cancer progression through STAT3 pathway activation and serves as an independent prognostic biomarker.

biomarkers.title: Effect of the miR‑26a/b‑5p‑STAT3‑YKL‑40 regulatory axis on proliferation, migration, and invasion of endometrial cancer cells.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers found that blocking STAT3 protein in endometrial cancer cells reduces tumor growth, migration, and invasion through a regulatory pathway involving miR-26a/b-5p and YKL-40.

biomarkers.title: Betulinic acid alleviates the inflammatory injury of osteoblasts in osteoporosis by augmenting autophagy via the AMPK-mTOR signaling pathway.
biomarkers.summary: Betulinic acid protects bone cells from inflammatory damage in osteoporosis by activating autophagy through the AMPK-mTOR pathway.

biomarkers.title: snoRNAs and their derived sdRNAs: Emerging regulators, biomarkers, and therapeutic targets in human cancers (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Small nucleolar RNAs (snoRNAs) control cancer cell growth and spread, offering new opportunities for diagnosis and treatment across multiple cancer types.

biomarkers.title: PTPRN2-mediated silencing of tumor-intrinsic MHC-II promotes immune-excluded tumor microenvironment in colorectal cancer.
biomarkers.summary: PTPRN2 suppresses immune responses in colorectal cancer by silencing MHC-II; blocking it restores immunotherapy effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: Optimal timing of PD-1 inhibitor immunotherapy administration to stereotactic radiosurgery in malignant gliomas: a propensity score-matched multi-institutional cohort study.
biomarkers.summary: Study investigates optimal timing of combining immunotherapy and radiation for brain tumors to improve survival and neurological outcomes.

trials.title: Integrative Oncology Training for Supportive Care Nurses in the Middle-East.
trials.summary: Nurses in the Middle East are being trained to deliver integrative oncology programs that combine conventional cancer treatment with supportive care therapies.

trials.title: Impact of fetal myelomeningocele repair on the clivus-supraocciput angle and third ventricle anatomy: evaluation of the outcome of endoscopic third ventriculostomy and choroid plexus cauterization.
trials.summary: Fetal spine surgery reverses brain herniation and improves brain fluid drainage, reducing need for additional procedures.

trials.title: Optimal timing of PD-1 inhibitor immunotherapy administration to stereotactic radiosurgery in malignant gliomas: a propensity score-matched multi-institutional cohort study.
trials.summary: Study investigates optimal timing of combining immunotherapy and radiation for brain tumors to improve survival and neurological outcomes.

trials.title: Engagement of Users in Digital Health Applications: Scoping Review.
trials.summary: Mobile health apps improve health outcomes when users stay engaged, but many apps suffer from low adoption and quick abandonment rates.

trials.title: Overall Survival Among Patients With Hepatocellular Carcinoma Treated With External Beam Radiation Therapy: Individual Patient Data Outcomes From a Multinational Cohort.
trials.summary: Researchers analyzed international patient data to assess whether radiation therapy improves survival in liver cancer patients.

trials.title: Distinct Inflammatory Cytotoxic T Lymphocyte Populations Mediate PD-1 Blockade Induced Immune-Related Adverse Events in Multiple Organs.
trials.summary: Blocking JAK1 signaling in specific immune cells relieves cancer immunotherapy side effects in heart and lung without reducing anti-tumor effectiveness.

trials.title: Reprogramming CAR with cytokine signaling increases the efficacy of CAR-T cell therapy in solid tumour treatment and confers sustained immune memory.
trials.summary: Engineers added cytokine signaling to CAR-T cells, creating S71, which improved treatment effectiveness against solid tumors and sustained immune memory.

trials.title: TP53-mutant AML with ribosomal gene loss exhibits impaired protein translation and sensitivity to HSP90 inhibition.
trials.summary: TP53-mutant AML with ribosomal gene loss becomes vulnerable to HSP90 inhibitor treatment through impaired protein production.

trials.title: P300/CBP inhibition with inobrodib in combination with gilteritinib and venetoclax targets leukemia stem cells in epigenetic mutant AML.
trials.summary: A three-drug combination targeting AML stem cells shows promise for treating aggressive blood cancer with minimal side effects.

trials.title: Helper lipid-engineered extracellular vesicles enable PET imaging-guided pulmonary siRNA delivery to treat lung metastasis.
trials.summary: Modified extracellular vesicles successfully deliver cancer-fighting siRNA to lung tumors, improving immune response against melanoma metastasis.

trials.title: Analysis of Torquetenovirus DNA levels in NSCLC patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors.
trials.summary: TTV viral levels decreased in lung cancer patients after immunotherapy, suggesting immune function improved and potentially serving as a treatment response marker.

trials.title: Real world experience with cyclin dependent kinase inhibitors in metastatic breast cancer in India.
trials.summary: Indian breast cancer patients taking palbociclib or ribociclib showed real-world effectiveness in treating advanced hormone-responsive disease.

trials.title: Bladder-preserving trimodality therapy for muscle-invasive bladder cancer: current state of the art.
trials.summary: Trimodality therapy combining surgery, radiation, and chemotherapy allows muscle-invasive bladder cancer patients to preserve their bladder while improving survival.

trials.title: Association of Complement Genetics with Outcomes in IgA Nephropathy.
trials.summary: Genetic variations in complement genes are associated with IgA nephropathy severity and outcomes in affected patients.

trials.title: MRI Habitat Analysis for Preoperative Prediction of Perineural Invasion and Prognostic Stratification in Rectal Cancer.
trials.summary: MRI imaging can help doctors predict nerve involvement in rectal cancer before surgery to better plan treatment.
